caption: The drawing shows a single upholstered armchair with high, curved sides and a tall, rounded back. The chair's fabric is decorated with alternating light and dark green vertical stripes. The armrests curve outward and slightly downward, with the front ends scrolling outward in a rounded fashion. The chair stands on four wooden legs; the two front legs are turned, featuring decorative vertical grooves, and are brown in color, while the back legs are plain and angled. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, with no other objects present. There is a handwritten signature at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Wing Chair
